verdict.rationale: Polar publishes a documented, versioned OpenAPI 3.1 spec, official typed SDKs (TypeScript/Python), webhooks, and llms.txt/agent-legible docs, giving AI-native users a fully documented public API surface to drive the product programmatically. missing for 10: independent third-party corroboration of the API's stability/completeness beyond first-party docs, and the probe showing openapi.json not reachable at the root domain (spec is only under /docs).
